# Reed Creative Labs

> Reed Creative Labs is a veteran-founded, family-built independent software and engineering studio in South Carolina. Its mission is to build software that explores complex systems through desktop tools, scientific simulation, procedural media, games, and focused client work.

Products described as Active Development, Prototype, Research, Private Beta, or Concept are not represented as released products. Product pages state the current public development status and known platform scope.

The public website is a static Next.js App Router application built with React and TypeScript. Its homepage includes a procedurally generated visualization whose canonical state system is authored in modern Fortran and compiled to WebAssembly; browser code handles lifecycle and rendering. Product pages distinguish working screenshots from abstract or unavailable media.

## Primary Products

- [Forge](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/forge): A local-first software engineering environment for sustained work on real repositories and codebases. Active Development for Windows.
- [Forgefield](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/forgefield): A native Windows procedural-rendering project for live wallpapers and screensavers. Active Development.
- [RCL Science Lab](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/rcl-science-lab): Educational software for interactive scientific simulations, visualization, and guided exploration. Active Development for desktop.
- [Storm Lab](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/storm-lab): A working meteorological simulation research prototype connecting a native atmospheric model to map-based visualization. Prototype for Windows.
- [Phase Arcade Volume I](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/phase-arcade-volume-1): Three focused arcade games for traditional desktop play and VR: Phase Shift, Phase Breaker, and Phase Court. Active Development.
